rationale: X has a specific, convincing hero product visual (policy summary card with flood-zone illustration, risk gauge and premium saving) and a warm, cohesive palette that feels tied to the flood-risk story, though the 1 in 75 yr label collides with the house art. Y has strong serif typography and clean icon cards, but its hero card is generic and the tiles and layout follow the familiar SaaS template. A design director would ship X.
